channel.title: The Box Plus Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Sudan: RSF siege of El Fasher bore ‘hallmarks of genocide’ – UN report
item.description: A UN report has found the actions of the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary, in the Sudanese city of El Fasher, bear the ‘hallmarks of genocide’.

item.title: Trump’s Board of Peace meet to talk Gaza, Iran and UN
item.description: Representatives of more than 45 nations gathered in Washington for a meeting of President Trump's new Board of Peace.

item.title: Does Andrew’s arrest shatter the image of the Royal family?
item.description: Detectives detained the eighth in line to the throne and brother of the King shortly after 8am on Thursday morning, as part of an investigation into claims of misconduct in public office.

item.title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor arrested on suspicion of misconduct in public office
item.description: Shortly after 10am on Thursday morning Thames Valley Police confirmed that detectives had arrested a man in his 60s from Norfolk on suspicion of misconduct in public office.

item.title: Police commence searches of royal homes as Andrew arrested
item.description: We were outside Wood Farm in Sandringham, Andrew's home, where officers have been conducting a search of the property and his former residence, the Royal Lodge in Windsor, where there's also been police activity.

item.title: ‘Huge crisis for the monarchy’ – royal commentator on Andrew’s arrest
item.description: We spoke to former adviser to Yvette Cooper and home affairs specialist, Danny Shaw and royal commentator Sarah Hewson.

item.title: Andrew urged to testify before the House Oversight Committee over Epstein links
item.description: The Democrat Congressman Suhas Subramanyam sits on the House Oversight Committee, which has been investigating Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Could Andrew’s arrest in the UK lead to more action by US lawmakers?
item.description: The decision by police to begin this investigation follows the US Department of Justice's publication of millions of files from its investigations into Jeffrey Epstein and comes after growing calls for the former Prince to answer questions before US Congress.

item.title: Andrew: What could the misconduct investigation reveal about Epstein’s activities?
item.description: It’s been just three weeks since millions more Epstein files went live, prompting the inquiry into misconduct in public office by Thames Valley Police.

item.title: Survivors want Andrew to ‘pay consequences’, says lawyer for Epstein’s victims
item.description: We spoke to US lawyer, Gloria Allred, who has represented 27 survivors of Jeffrey Epstein's abuse.
